analysis.title: The "Volatility Of Protection" Hits A Record: Goldman's Vol Desk On The Biggest Put Day Ever... And An Nvidia Collar That Aged Badly
key_insights: Last Thursday saw a record 55.8M put contracts traded across all US venues, about 3.4x the 10-year daily average of 16.4M. Volume has since cooled to about 30.8M, still nearly double the decade average.

Goldman describes positioning as light (US net leverage at 5-year lows per GS PB, 43.3% net for US fundamental long/short funds after the biggest weekly degross since March 2020), the vol complex as jittery (Panic Index 6.5/10) and options volumes as ballooned.

VVIX 1-month realized vol reached 208, the highest in Goldman's 10-year chart and about 2.6x its average of 81. VVIX had its 2nd largest one-day increase on record last Thursday and a top-10 one-day decline on Monday.

Goldman likes owning index downside skew because the Street is structurally short vol on the way down and long vol on the way up, which should create an asymmetric bid for protection on any meaningful selloff. Nomura's McElligott argues the VIX floor has moved up to 18 but the fuel for another squeeze has been purged.
Macro trade: SPX Dec 18 7300/7850 risk reversal for $29 (-41 delta, December futures at 7600). The put is struck 3.9% below futures and financed mostly by selling a call 3.3% above.

The average Nasdaq 100 stock carries 1-month ATM implied vol of about 44. Goldman's AI Data Center basket (GSTMTDAT) has realized roughly 80 vol over the past month, above its Liberation Day high and 2.6x its five-year average of 31.

BofA derivatives noted hyperscaler implied vols have barely moved while credit spreads widened to five-year wides. Goldman's data shows the equity pain concentrated in builders, lessors and neoclouds at the levered end of the AI chain.

Goldman's NVDA 18Dec26 150/180/210 call spread collar at zero cost (ref 166.50) was pitched Wednesday morning after NVDA fell nearly 30% since early October, erasing over $1.75tn in market cap, to about 24x P/E. NVDA closed Wednesday at $173.73, then fell 8.6% after hours to $158.78 (low $156.20) on reports the board is preparing to remove its founder.

The after-hours move took out about 47% of the collar's 10% cushion before the next regular session. The structure has no loss at expiry unless NVDA is below $150 on Dec 18, and it is short vol into a board event and next week's earnings report.

Small-cap vol is cheap per Goldman: the IWM vs SPY 2-month implied vol spread is 3.4 vol points against an average of 6.4 since late 2020 and a high near 12, near the tightest since Covid. Russell positioning is thin ahead of a historically strong seasonal stretch.

Small-cap trades: IWM Dec 31 295 calls for $2.33 (21 delta, ref $280.58, breakeven $297.33), or the same call with a continuous knock-out if SPY touches 800 for $0.98, a 53% discount, giving equal IWM and SPY vega exposure.

The author caveats that small caps are the most rate-sensitive equity segment, and rates are moving against them: Tuesday's hot CPI lifted hike odds, Goldman expects a third rate hike in March 2027, and Treasury futures implied a 10Y back above 5% on Wednesday.

Biopharma has drawn buyers since the midterms on secular tailwinds, revived M&A appetite and broadening-beneficiary status. For the second quarter in a row almost every large-cap biopharma company beat on revenue and most raised guidance.

Goldman pitched two Feb 19, 2027 dual binaries: NDX below 95% of spot with 2Y SOFR more than 25bps above forward costs 8.5% (implied payout about 11.8 to 1), and NDX above 110% with 2Y SOFR more than 25bps below forward costs 7.75% (about 12.9 to 1). Both price below the independent-leg cost of about 9.4% and 8.5%, so correlation pricing still assumes stocks and yields fall together.

The author sees 'stocks down, rates up' as arguably the base case with the Fed hiking into an AI unwind, and the 11.8-to-1 binary as pricing the last regime. After-hours Wednesday, Nasdaq 100 futures were down about 1.1% and S&P futures down 0.5%, nearly half of the 1.10% weekly SPX straddle.

market_movers.rationale: Goldman's desk pitched a zero-cost 150/180/210 call spread collar to add length with a 10% downside cushion. The stock then fell 8.6% after hours on reports the board is preparing to remove its founder.
Small-cap implied vol is near multi-year lows relative to SPY, with thin positioning heading into a strong seasonal stretch. Goldman offers the Dec 31 295 call, plain or with a SPY knock-out at 800.

sector_views.rationale: Positioning is thin, implied vol is cheap relative to the S&P and the seasonal stretch is historically strong. The author cautions that rates are a headwind.
Buyers have returned since the midterms on secular tailwinds, M&A appetite and consistent revenue beats and guidance raises.
The AI Data Center basket has realized about 80 vol and the levered end of the chain (builders, lessors, neoclouds) is taking the equity pain.

earnings_insights: Nvidia reports earnings next week (date not given in the note). The author flags that someone other than Jensen Huang may have to present, given the board removal reports.
For the second quarter in a row almost every large-cap biopharma company beat on revenue and most raised guidance (Goldman, no company figures given).

macro_indicators.interpretation: Options priced the S&P move through Friday as of Wednesday morning. The index had already covered the straddle by lunch and after-hours futures were down 0.5%.
The hot CPI sent hike odds soaring and stocks and bonds sold off together.
Goldman expects a third hike, which pressures rate-sensitive small caps.

macro_indicators.reading: Back above 5% implied by Treasury futures
macro_indicators.interpretation: A rising long yield works against small caps and supports the stocks-down, rates-up scenario.
Below the extremes of Covid, the GFC and Liberation Day, but jittery.

AI unwind concentrated in levered infrastructure names (builders, lessors, neoclouds), with hyperscaler credit spreads at five-year wides per BofA.
Hot CPI and rising hike odds, with a third Fed hike expected in March 2027 and the 10Y implied back above 5%.
Dealers buying back optionality in a real selloff, which can produce another protection bid and vol spike.
Light positioning (US net leverage at 5-year lows) leaves the market sensitive to headlines.
vol_and_positioning: Record 55.8M US put contracts last Thursday versus a 16.4M 10-year daily average. Cboe alone traded more than 11.2M puts. Volume has since cooled to about 30.8M.
US net leverage on GS Prime is at a 5-year low. US fundamental long/short funds were 43.3% net after the biggest weekly degross since March 2020.
VVIX 1-month realized vol of 208 is the highest in the 10-year chart, 2.6x its 81 average. VVIX posted its 2nd largest one-day rise on record last Thursday and a top-10 one-day drop on Monday.
Street is short vol on the way down and long vol on the way up. Goldman likes owning downside skew in the index.
Nasdaq 100 average 1-month ATM implied vol is about 44. The AI Data Center basket realized about 80 vol, 2.6x its 5-year average of 31.
IWM vs SPY 2-month implied vol spread of 3.4 points is near the tightest since Covid (average 6.4, high near 12).
Dual binaries imply a correlation market that still prices stocks and yields falling together.
geopolitical: US midterm elections the prior week, which the author says upended the AI trade.
cross_bank_references: Nomura's McElligott: VIX floor has moved up to 18 but the fuel for another squeeze has been purged. Goldman agrees on the first part and reads the S&P options differently on the second.
BofA derivatives ('Markets May Not Wait'): hyperscaler implied vols have barely budged while credit spreads widened to five-year wides.

tension_points.bull_case: Goldman sees a durable asymmetric bid for index protection because the Street is short vol on the way down and long vol on the way up, so downside skew stays rich on any meaningful selloff.
tension_points.bear_case: Nomura's McElligott argues leveraged ETN holders have cashed out and VIX options dealers are long gamma, so nobody is left to chase VIX higher and the fuel for another squeeze is purged.

tension_points.bull_case: Selling a put 10% out of the money on a stock already down nearly 30% is a defensible way to get long. The structure has no loss at expiry unless NVDA is below $150 on Dec 18.
tension_points.bear_case: The trade is short vol into a board removal report and next week's earnings, and 47% of the cushion went in after-hours trading before the next regular session.

tension_points.bull_case: The IWM/SPY implied vol spread is near its tightest since Covid, Russell positioning is thin and the seasonal stretch is strong.
tension_points.bear_case: Small caps are the most rate-sensitive equities, with a hot CPI, a third Fed hike expected in March 2027 and the 10Y implied above 5%.
